Carey |manager2 = |previous = [[1961–62 National Hurling League|1961–62]] |next = [[1963–64 National Hurling League|1963–64]] }} The '''1962–63 National Hurling League''' was the 32nd season of the NHL, an annual [[hurling]] competition for the [[GAA county teams]].{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} {{GG|Waterford|hurling}} won their second title. ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |season=1962-63 |winners=[[Waterford GAA|Waterford]]
1st National League title

On 3 November 1963, [[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] won the title after a 3-10 to 1-10 win over [[New York GAA|New York]] in the final replay.
